layers.name: Site of Importance for Nature Conservation (SINC)
layers.scope: Wildlife and biodiversity protection; three SINC tiers. Indicative GIS boundary requires confirmation by the relevant London Borough.
layers.field_type_note: HasZ/HasM true; shape geometry; hectares/easting/northing numeric; lifecycle strings.

layers.name: Conservation Areas
layers.scope: Special architectural and historic interest with additional planning controls; indicative boundary requires borough confirmation.
layers.field_type_note: No Z/M; integer easting/northing; lifecycle strings; polygon geom.

layers.name: Designated Open Space (Metropolitan Open Land)
layers.scope: Metropolitan Open Land receives Green Belt-equivalent development protection; indicative boundary requires borough confirmation.
layers.field_type_note: No Z/M; integer easting/northing; polygon geom; missing field present.

layers.name: Designated Open Space (Other Open Space)
layers.scope: Other designated public open space with public value; indicative boundary requires borough confirmation.
layers.field_type_note: No Z/M; integer easting/northing; polygon geom; missing field present.

layers.name: Ancient Woodland
layers.scope: Woodland continuously wooded since at least 1600; loss or deterioration should be refused except wholly exceptional cases. Indicative boundary requires borough confirmation.
layers.field_type_note: No Z/M; hectares/easting/northing published as strings; polygon geom.

layers.name: Thames Policy Area (LPA)
layers.scope: Local-plan Thames Policy Area; proposals should align with the relevant Thames Strategy. Indicative boundary requires borough confirmation.
layers.field_type_note: No Z/M; hectares/easting/northing published as strings; polygon geom.

layers.name: Protected Vistas (Extension)
layers.scope: London View Management Framework protected-view extension; visual-impact assessment and policy compliance are required. Indicative boundary requires borough confirmation.
layers.field_type_note: No Z/M; hectares/easting/northing published as strings; polygon geom.

layers.name: scheduled_monuments
layers.scope: Official service confirms the scheduled_monuments layer identity and polygon schema, but publishes no layer description or copyright text on the layer page; no policy or candidate inference is added.
layers.field_type_note: No Z/M; first/last dates are date fields; numeric hectares/easting/northing; shape geometry.

operation_plan.candidate_routing: Every candidate is routed to each audited current official protection layer; route presence is not membership.
operation_plan.extent_policy: All 24 extent relations are revalidations of previously audited named-layer results. They do not increment the cumulative exact-extent counter.
